knowledge:
- key_parameters: <boolUpdates=The number of simulation steps (ticks) to run, which must be manually set based on model size and experimental time ;; lowerB=The lower bound for the optimization of the time-scaling factor ;; upperB=The upper bound for the optimization of the time-scaling factor ;; maxTime=The maximum time allowed for the genetic algorithm optimization in seconds ;; initBstring=A binary vector of 1s and 0s representing the initial active/inactive state of reactions in the model>
- alternatives: <CellNOptR=The parent package, which should be preferred when fitting models to steady-state data (where simulation runs until all species are static) rather than time-course data>
- when_to_use: <When you have time-course proteomics data and a prior knowledge network, and you want to train a boolean logic model that captures dynamic behaviors, feedback loops, or oscillations across multiple time points>
- pitfalls: <The scaling parameter approach is simplified because it assumes a single uniform rate across all reactions in the model ;; The boolUpdates parameter must be manually specified by the user as there is currently no automated default calculation>

workflows.name: time_course_logic_modeling
workflows.intent: Train and optimize a boolean logic model of a signaling network using time-course experimental data.
input: CNOlistPB (CNOlist object containing time-course proteomics data)
modelPB (Model object representing the prior knowledge network)
workflows.stages: 1. Load libraries and data ;; 2. Preprocess the model against the dataset ;; 3. Run genetic algorithm optimization with time-scaling parameters ;; 4. Plot and visualize the fit of the optimized model ;; 5. Export the optimized network and scaffold files
workflows.code:
library(CellNOptR)
library(CNORdt)
data(CNOlistPB, package="CNORdt")
data(modelPB, package="CNORdt")
model = preprocessing(CNOlistPB, modelPB)
initBstring <- rep(1, length(model$reacID))
opt1 <- gaBinaryDT(CNOlist=CNOlistPB, model=model, initBstring=initBstring,
verbose=FALSE, boolUpdates=10, maxTime=30, lowerB=0.8, upperB=10)
cutAndPlotResultsDT(
	model=model,
	CNOlist=CNOlistPB,
	bString=opt1$bString,
	plotPDF=FALSE,
	boolUpdates=10,
	lowerB=0.8,
	upperB=10
)
writeScaffold(
	modelComprExpanded=model,
	optimResT1=opt1,
	optimResT2=NA,
	modelOriginal=modelPB,
	CNOlist=CNOlistPB
)
writeNetwork(
	modelOriginal=modelPB,
	modelComprExpanded=model,
	optimResT1=opt1,
	CNOlist=CNOlistPB
)
